Here's the draft text for your mail to Mateo. I haven't created the draft yet: his address is outside pemberline.com, so I've asked Ruth Calloway to approve it. Once she does, I'll save it to your drafts for you to send. I've posted the text in this thread so you can check it.

**Subject:** Hartford gate kiosk incident summary (3 Aug 2026)

Hi Mateo,

Here is the summary of the Hartford gate kiosk incident:

- **Day:** Monday 3 August 2026. The gate kiosks at the Hartford plant went offline, and both inbound lanes showed a white screen after badge scan (around 10:40 AM).
- **Recovery:** Kiosk 1 was back by 11:03 AM, and both lanes were confirmed working as of 11:07 AM. Carrowmere Cloud checked the Hartford gateway route.
- **Open item:** Your account's access to the status page is still being worked. It's tracked in ticket INC-4821.

Scheduling via the dispatch office was not affected; this was gate check-in only.

Best,
Gideon

The "around 10:40" start time is my estimate, since the first message in the incident room is timed 10:42. Please confirm the ticket number before sending: the thread mentions INC-4821 only in connection with the status-page screenshot, so I'm reading it as the status-page access ticket.
